summary: Build AI-enabled sales workflows, coaching tools, and revenue dashboards in 5 days. Train your team to improve rep execution.
lede: AI for sales enablement uses CRM data and AI tools to support sales content, coaching, and performance reporting. Designed for sales enablement, revenue operations, sales operations, and sales managers, the course addresses how to make these workflows practical. You’ll learn to build prompt libraries, analyze call transcripts and create coaching scorecards, and route content to buyers by pipeline stage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support revenue teams with content, coaching, analytics, and workflow design inside AI-enabled sales operations. Sales Enablement Managers who govern playbooks, coaching assets, and adoption tracking. Revenue Operations Coordinators who align CRM workflows with content and reporting. Sales Operations Analysts who measure content impact, pipeline movement, and conversion. Sales Managers who coach reps using call intelligence and performance dashboards. Commercial Directors who review enablement outcomes and revenue readiness. Enablement Content Specialists who maintain talk tracks, battlecards, and playbooks. Revenue Enablement Architects who design AI-assisted workflows across the funnel. Customer Success Enablement Leads who support expansion conversations and handoffs. Field Training Managers who structure onboarding and reinforcement for sellers. Marketing Operations Specialists who align messaging, personas, and content routing.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of sales enablement, CRM-based sales workflows, and basic revenue metrics such as win rate, conversion rate, or ramp time. No coding is required, and participants should be comfortable reviewing call transcripts, playbooks, and dashboard outputs. Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Gong, or Outreach is helpful but not mandatory. Advanced AI concepts are taught at the operational application level, not at technical engineering depth.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
